reviews.review:
Works on steam deck so far. 👌 Update: Beat the game on Steam Deck

Update: You will want to tone down the graphics pretty heavily to get an almost constant 60fps

Battery seems to last close to 3 hours, unit will definitely heat up while playing.

Been doing a sniper playthrough, 1-shotting most things has been cathartic when compared to my last playthrough attempt years ago.

Most definitely a solid-yet-flawed title, I wish there was more build diversity outside of "Specific gun and two-hit melee." Would've been really cool to see a more melee/tank class that uses a shield or something.

If you can get past the rage-bait encounters, you're in for a surprisingly good time.

Final Update: Beat the game, who ever came up with that ending was an absolute madman. Absolutely ridiculous. Loved almost every second of it tbh, almost makes me want to play through it again.....almost. Definitely worth another revisit after a couple of years.
